plantNote: Your name and plant are on the Planting Log. Use Edit there to change them.
removeMine: Remove my name and log from this device
removeHelp: Deletes {name}'s name, entries and photos. Other people's logs on this device stay.
removeText: This deletes {name}'s name and their {count} and photos from this device. Other people's logs stay. You cannot undo this.
clearAllText: This deletes every name, log entry and photo, and resets your settings. You cannot undo this.
pdfTip: Tip: save a PDF first if you want to keep a copy.
facilitatorSharedDevice: Each device keeps its own logs. On a shared device, each student adds their name with "Who's logging?" on the Planting Log and sees only their own entries.
